components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. One of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned as the composed, normalized
            address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of a structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; an owner is valid
            when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or
            the flat 'address'), plus a city. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of a structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When omitted on create, it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date

## Summary

I implemented `capacityWarning` on owner creation, mirroring the existing `bulkSignupWarning` pattern. It's `true` when the owner's city already holds **40–49 owners** (inclusive) at create time — approaching the hard limit of 50, which `RequireCityCapacity` still rejects with 409 unchanged.

Changes:

- **New pipeline step** — `rest/function/owner/AssignCapacityWarning.java`: counts existing owners in the city using the *same* `findAll().stream().filter(city)` logic as `RequireCityCapacity`, then sets `capacityWarning = count >= 40 && count < RequireCityCapacity.CAPACITY`. It runs after `BuildOwner` (city set) and before `SaveOwner` (new owner not counted).
- **Wiring** — `officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`: inserted `assignCapacityWarning` between `assignBulkSignupWarning` and `assignPossibleDuplicate`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`.
- **Domain model** — `model/Owner.java`: added the `capacity_warning` column field with getter/setter.
- **Response mapping** — `mapper/OwnerMapper.java`: added the `capacityWarning` mapping (null-safe, defaults false), so it serializes on `GET /api/owners/{id}`.
- **OpenAPI schema** — `openapi.yml`: added the read-only `capacityWarning` boolean property (this is what generates the `OwnerDto` field).
- **DB schemas** — added `capacity_warning` to all four (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`).

Test result: `AcceptanceTest` (`coreWarnsWhenApproachingCapacity`) and the full suite pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`, 0 failures.

I referenced the counting rule from `RequireCityCapacity` deliberately so the warning tracks the same limit it approaches — including that both count *all* owners in the city (deleted owners included), consistent with the existing hard-limit behavior.
